answer.justification: Only output-level data is available. Exact-match is 0.016 and median first divergence is 10, both inside the quantized range (0.016-0.031 and 10-17). Fine-tuned models usually diverge earlier (5.5-8), and system-prompted models diverge at token 0 with exact-match 0, so both fit poorly. Edit distance 0.516 is just under the quantized range (0.52-0.57) and far from the system-prompted range (0.79-0.82). Refusal, disclaimer, short-reply and length rates match the reference almost exactly, with 0 refusals added or dropped, which is typical of quantization. The stage-direction rate is 4.7% against 3.1% for the reference, a one-reply difference. Fine-tuned is the closest alternative, since its output ranges overlap with this case, but the median divergence of 10 and the near-identical text rates favor quantized. Base is ruled out because the replies are not identical.
